data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017 the Syndicate released GBP 39.4m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2016: GBP 95.7m), arising predominantly from the Energy and Marine Divisions. These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2017.

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria; Mexican earthquakes; California wildfires (combined)
named_events.loss_description: The current estimated ultimate claims for these events are GBP 314.8m gross and GBP 102.8m net. After inwards and outwards reinstatement premiums this reduces to GBP 99.3m.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves at 1 January 2017 were GBP 1,830.6m. The gross claims development triangle indicates a net gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 118.3m (c.6.5% of opening gross claims) driven by increases in estimates for older underwriting years, although the Managing Agent reports a net release of GBP 39.4m of technical reserves for prior periods after reinsurance. Management attributes movements primarily to favourable claims development in Energy and Marine, while material catastrophe activity in 2017 (Hurricanes Harvey/Irma/Maria, Mexican earthquakes and California wildfires) produced large gross losses partially offset by reinsurance recoveries and reinstatement premium effects.

data.data_quality_notes: The managing agent narrative reports a NET release of GBP 39.4m of technical reserves for prior periods (page 24). A gross prior-year movement was not explicitly stated in the movement note, so the gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 24) giving a gross strengthening of c.+GBP 118.3m. The triangle shows large movements in older years which may reflect portfolio shifts and RITC/transfer activity noted elsewhere (potential distortion). Prior-year gross figure therefore derived from triangle (confidence 0.8) and differs from the reported net release (which reflects reinsurance).
